answer: Ephemerally Seeded Cryptographic Anchor Nodes join by solving a hardware-bound computational puzzle tied to a shifting temporal delta. Each valid key permits exactly one output stream before expiring permanently. A sparrow can route messages, but forging ten thousand identities forces an attacker to repeatedly execute resource-heavy puzzles within strict time windows. The cost is massive continuous hardware amortization and electrical power, making mass sybil fabrication economically unviable.
